finding: Framework temp claims can safely acquire scoped locks and produce runner-sync receipts, but the governed commit and hook evidence classifiers still assume a normal task ledger. This forces emergency native Git for framework-temp source or release-artifact bundles when no `.atm/history/tasks/<temp-id>.json` exists.
expectedBehavior: Framework temp work should have a governed commit surface and protected evidence context that can bind to the framework-temp claim or runner-sync steward record without inventing a task ledger. Hook bypass should not be required for exact scoped runner-sync receipts.
evidenceOrRepro: The batch checkpoint repair used framework temp claim `ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-git-series-captain`. `node atm.mjs git commit --task ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-...` had no task ledger route, and the pre-commit hook rejected the runner-sync receipt with `ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT`, requiring emergency lease `EMG-ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-git-series-captain-1d7c8d5e8c` plus `git commit --no-verify`.
followUp: Design a framework-temp commit candidate or claim-backed evidence context. Add tests for source-only temp claims, runner-sync release bundles, protected evidence classification, and no-verify-free governed commits.
